title: G6 transmitter with a space won't connect or send alert
body:
Minor bug. If by error one enters a space character after the G6 transmitter serial number (cut and paste can do that), xDrip will not connect and will not give any errors (except that there are no new BGs)

See discussion below with log capture.

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2884

comments.body: The issue should be resolved in the July 1st nightly which is available now.
